subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what storage, validation, auth, and identity-precedence rules should it use?
rationale: The requested feature crosses a new file-upload and workspace-write boundary, so automation should not choose the product or security policy silently.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps current read-route protections.

options.title: Keep browser-local override
options.body: Continue supporting Quick Settings overrides and manual `IDENTITY.md` or CLI paths without adding server-side upload risk.

options.title: Defer broader identity management
options.body: Keep this open or defer it until a larger Control UI identity-management design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps current read-route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original avatar support PR and is the best available routing candidate for the avatar upload product/security boundary.
